::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Isaiah proclaims God's holiness, judgment, and salvation while pointing repeatedly to the coming Messiah. The book teaches that hope is found in trusting the Holy One of Israel. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Isaiah 1:18
Come now, let us reason together
### Why This Verse One of Isaiah's most famous invitations ### Chapter Insight This chapter calls Judah to repentance despite widespread rebellion. The key verse reveals God's willingness to forgive and restore those who turn to Him. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Isaiah 2:4
They shall beat their swords into plowshares
### Why This Verse Iconic peace prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter looks forward to the future reign of the Lord. The key verse envisions all nations coming to God's mountain for instruction and peace. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Isaiah 3:10
Say ye to the righteous, it shall be well
### Why This Verse Encouragement amid judgment ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces judgment upon Judah's leaders and society. The key verse highlights the consequences of abandoning God's ways. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Isaiah 4:2
The Branch of the LORD shall be beautiful
### Why This Verse Early messianic prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises future cleansing and restoration. The key verse points to the Branch of the Lord and God's redeeming work. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Isaiah 5:20
Woe unto them that call evil good
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted moral warning ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents the song of the vineyard. The key verse reveals God's disappointment with His people's failure to produce righteousness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Isaiah 6:8
Here am I; send me
### Why This Verse One of the Bible's most famous calls to service ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Isaiah's vision and calling. The key verse expresses Isaiah's willingness to serve after encountering God's holiness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Isaiah 7:14
A virgin shall conceive
### Why This Verse Major messianic prophecy quoted in Matthew ### Chapter Insight This chapter offers King Ahaz a sign of God's faithfulness. The key verse contains the prophecy of Immanuel, pointing to God's presence with His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Isaiah 8:12
Fear not their fear
### Why This Verse Trust God rather than men ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns of coming judgment while encouraging trust in God. The key verse emphasizes revering the Lord rather than fearing people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Isaiah 9:6
Unto us a child is born
### Why This Verse One of the greatest messianic prophecies ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises hope through the coming Messiah. The key verse describes the child who will reign with justice and peace. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Isaiah 10:27
His yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing
### Why This Verse Frequently cited deliverance verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces judgment on Assyria despite its role in God's purposes. The key verse highlights God's sovereignty over nations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Isaiah 11:6
The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb
### Why This Verse Famous kingdom peace imagery ### Chapter Insight This chapter foretells the reign of the Messiah. The key verse presents the Spirit-filled descendant of Jesse who will rule righteously. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Isaiah 12:2
God is my salvation
### Why This Verse Song of trust ### Chapter Insight This chapter is a song of praise for God's salvation. The key verse celebrates trust in God without fear. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Isaiah 13:11
I will punish the world for its evil
### Why This Verse Judgment theme ### Chapter Insight This chapter prophesies Babylon's downfall. The key verse demonstrates God's authority over kingdoms and history. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Isaiah 14:12
How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer
### Why This Verse One of the most discussed prophetic verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues judgment against Babylon and prideful rulers. The key verse warns against self-exaltation before God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Isaiah 15:5
My heart shall cry out for Moab
### Why This Verse Compassion in judgment ### Chapter Insight This chapter laments the coming judgment upon Moab. The key verse reflects sorrow over the consequences of national rebellion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Isaiah 16:5
A throne shall be established in mercy
### Why This Verse Messianic kingdom theme ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues the prophecy against Moab. The key verse points to mercy and righteous rule as humanity's true hope. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Isaiah 17:7
At that day shall a man look to his Maker
### Why This Verse Turning back to God ### Chapter Insight This chapter prophesies judgment on Damascus and Israel. The key verse calls people to remember their Creator rather than trust earthly securities. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Isaiah 18:7
A present shall be brought unto the LORD
### Why This Verse Nations acknowledging God ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses distant nations and God's sovereign purposes. The key verse emphasizes waiting upon God's timing. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Isaiah 19:25
Blessed be Egypt My people
### Why This Verse Remarkable inclusion of the nations ### Chapter Insight This chapter foretells judgment and eventual restoration for Egypt. The key verse reveals God's desire to bring even foreign nations into His blessing. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Isaiah 20:3
Isaiah walked naked and barefoot
### Why This Verse Pr ### Chapter Insight This chapter uses Isaiah's actions as a sign against misplaced trust in alliances. The key verse warns against relying on human powers instead of God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Isaiah 21:11
Watchman, what of the night?
### Why This Verse Famous prophetic question ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces judgment on Babylon and other nations. The key verse captures the watchman's urgent message concerning coming events. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Isaiah 22:22
The key of the house of David
### Why This Verse Quoted in Revelation ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses Jerusalem's false confidence. The key verse points to God's authority and ultimately foreshadows the Messianic King who holds the key of David. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Isaiah 23:18
Her merchandise shall be holiness to the LORD
### Why This Verse Tyre ultimately redeemed ### Chapter Insight This chapter prophesies judgment against Tyre. The key verse highlights the temporary nature of earthly wealth and commercial power. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Isaiah 24:5
The earth is defiled under its inhabitants
### Why This Verse Universal judgment theme ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes worldwide judgment. The key verse reveals God's sovereignty over all the earth and its inhabitants. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
Isaiah 25:8
He will swallow up death in victory
### Why This Verse Quoted in 1 Corinthians 15 ### Chapter Insight This chapter offers praise for God's future victory and salvation. The key verse celebrates God's ultimate defeat of death and suffering. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
Isaiah 26:3
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace
### Why This Verse One of Isaiah's most beloved promises ### Chapter Insight This chapter is a song of trust and hope. The key verse emphasizes perfect peace for those whose minds are fixed on God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
Isaiah 27:6
Israel shall blossom and bud
### Why This Verse Restoration promise ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises God's future restoration of Israel. The key verse depicts God's victory over evil and His care for His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
Isaiah 28:16
Behold, I lay in Zion a cornerstone
### Why This Verse Major messianic prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns against pride and false security. The key verse introduces the cornerstone that provides a sure foundation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 29
Isaiah 29:13
This people draw near with their mouth
### Why This Verse Quoted by Jesus ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses Jerusalem's spiritual blindness. The key verse warns against outward religion without heartfelt devotion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 30
Isaiah 30:21
This is the way, walk ye in it
### Why This Verse Guidance verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter rebukes reliance upon foreign alliances. The key verse reveals that strength is found in repentance and trust. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 31
Isaiah 31:1
Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help
### Why This Verse Trust in God, not human strength ### Chapter Insight This chapter continues the warning against trusting Egypt. The key verse emphasizes dependence upon God rather than military power. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 32
Isaiah 32:17
The work of righteousness shall be peace
### Why This Verse Kingdom blessing ### Chapter Insight This chapter foretells a righteous king and restored kingdom. The key verse points to the transforming work of God's Spirit. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 33
Isaiah 33:6
Wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts judgment with future glory. The key verse celebrates God as Judge, Lawgiver, and King. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 34
Isaiah 34:16
Seek ye out of the book of the LORD
### Why This Verse Appeal to God's word ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces judgment upon the nations. The key verse highlights God's justice against persistent rebellion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 35
Isaiah 35:10
The redeemed of the LORD shall return
### Why This Verse Restoration and joy ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises restoration and joy for God's redeemed people. The key verse describes the highway of holiness leading to Zion. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 36
Isaiah 36:4
Thus saith the great king
### Why This Verse Rabshakeh's challenge ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Assyria's challenge to Judah. The key verse exposes the futility of trusting human power over God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 37
Isaiah 37:14
Hezekiah spread it before the LORD
### Why This Verse Model of prayer in crisis ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Hezekiah's prayer and God's deliverance. The key verse demonstrates God's power to save those who trust Him. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 38
Isaiah 38:17
Thou hast cast all my sins behind Thy back
### Why This Verse Hezekiah's testimony ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Hezekiah's illness and healing. The key verse highlights God's mercy and responsiveness to prayer. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 39
Isaiah 39:6
The days come that all shall be carried to Babylon
### Why This Verse Babylonian exile foretold ### Chapter Insight This chapter reveals Hezekiah's pride before Babylonian envoys. The key verse foreshadows Judah's future exile. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 40
Isaiah 40:31
They that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted OT verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins Isaiah's message of comfort and hope. The key verse proclaims renewed strength for those who wait upon the Lord. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 41
Isaiah 41:10
Fear thou not; for I am with thee
### Why This Verse One of Scripture's greatest comfort verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter reassures Israel of God's presence and help. The key verse emphasizes God's sustaining power for His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 42
Isaiah 42:3
A bruised reed shall He not break
### Why This Verse Messianic prophecy quoted in Matthew ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces the Servant of the Lord. The key verse points to the Messiah who brings justice to the nations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 43
Isaiah 43:1
Fear not, for I have redeemed thee
### Why This Verse Redemption and belonging ### Chapter Insight This chapter celebrates God's redemption and covenant love. The key verse emphasizes God's presence through every trial. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 44
Isaiah 44:22
I have blotted out thy transgressions
### Why This Verse Powerful forgiveness imagery ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts the living God with idols. The key verse declares God's uniqueness as the first and the last. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 45
Isaiah 45:22
Look unto Me, and be ye saved
### Why This Verse One of Isaiah's greatest invitations ### Chapter Insight This chapter reveals God's sovereignty through Cyrus and His plan for Israel. The key verse declares that the Lord alone is God and there is no other. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 46
Isaiah 46:4
Even to your old age I am He
### Why This Verse Promise of lifelong care ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts God with powerless idols. The key verse emphasizes God's ability to carry and sustain His people throughout life. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 47
Isaiah 47:10
Thy wisdom and thy knowledge have perverted thee
### Why This Verse Warning against pride ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces judgment upon Babylon. The key verse reveals the downfall of pride and self-sufficiency. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 48
Isaiah 48:17
I am the LORD thy God who teaches thee to profit
### Why This Verse Divine guidance ### Chapter Insight This chapter rebukes Israel's stubbornness while affirming God's faithfulness. The key verse highlights God's refining work through adversity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 49
Isaiah 49:16
I have graven thee upon the palms of My hands
### Why This Verse Powerful image of God's remembrance ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents the Servant of the Lord as a light to the nations. The key verse expands God's salvation beyond Israel to all peoples. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 50
Isaiah 50:7
I have set my face like a flint
### Why This Verse Messianic determination ### Chapter Insight This chapter emphasizes the Servant's obedience amid suffering. The key verse demonstrates steadfast trust in God despite opposition. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 51
Isaiah 51:11
The redeemed of the LORD shall return
### Why This Verse Restoration promise ### Chapter Insight This chapter calls God's people to remember His faithfulness. The key verse encourages confidence in God's everlasting salvation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 52
Isaiah 52:7
How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet
### Why This Verse Quoted in Romans 10 ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces redemption and introduces the suffering Servant. The key verse proclaims the beauty of those who bring good news. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 53
Isaiah 53:5
He was wounded for our transgressions
### Why This Verse Perhaps the most important messianic prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the suffering and sacrifice of the Servant. The key verse reveals that the Servant bears the sins of others to bring healing and redemption. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 54
Isaiah 54:17
No weapon formed against thee shall prosper
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted promises in Scripture ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises restoration and covenant blessing. The key verse assures God's enduring love despite past affliction. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 55
Isaiah 55:8
My thoughts are not your thoughts
### Why This Verse Widely quoted statement of God's transcendence ### Chapter Insight This chapter invites all people to receive God's grace freely. The key verse calls the thirsty to come and receive God's provision. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 56
Isaiah 56:7
My house shall be called a house of prayer
### Why This Verse Quoted by Jesus ### Chapter Insight This chapter extends God's welcome to foreigners and outcasts. The key verse reveals God's desire for His house to be a house of prayer for all nations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 57
Isaiah 57:15
I dwell with him that is of a contrite spirit
### Why This Verse God's nearness to the humble ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts the fate of the righteous and the wicked. The key verse promises God's presence with the humble and repentant. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 58
Isaiah 58:6
Is not this the fast that I have chosen?
### Why This Verse Foundational justice passage ### Chapter Insight This chapter defines true fasting and genuine righteousness. The key verse emphasizes practical compassion and justice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 59
Isaiah 59:1
The LORD's hand is not shortened
### Why This Verse God's ability to save ### Chapter Insight This chapter explains how sin separates people from God. The key verse highlights God's power to save despite human failure. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 60
Isaiah 60:1
Arise, shine; for thy light is come
### Why This Verse One of Isaiah's most famous calls ### Chapter Insight This chapter foretells Zion's future glory. The key verse calls God's people to arise because His light has come. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 61
Isaiah 61:1
The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me
### Why This Verse Read by Jesus in Luke 4 ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents the mission of the Anointed One. The key verse proclaims good news, healing, liberty, and restoration. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 62
Isaiah 62:1
For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace
### Why This Verse Commitment to restoration ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises Jerusalem's future vindication. The key verse emphasizes God's commitment to His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 63
Isaiah 63:9
In all their affliction He was afflicted
### Why This Verse Divine compassion ### Chapter Insight This chapter reflects on God's past mercies and coming judgment. The key verse celebrates God's role as Redeemer. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 64
Isaiah 64:8
We are the clay, and Thou our potter
### Why This Verse Classic dependence imagery ### Chapter Insight This chapter is a prayer for God's intervention and mercy. The key verse acknowledges God's authority as Creator and Father. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 65
Isaiah 65:17
Behold, I create new heavens and a new earth
### Why This Verse Quoted in Revelation ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts judgment with future blessing. The key verse introduces the promise of a new heavens and a new earth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 66
Isaiah 66:13
As one whom his mother comforteth
### Why This Verse Tender image of God's comfort ### Chapter Insight This chapter concludes Isaiah with themes of worship, judgment, and restoration. The key verse emphasizes humility and reverence before God. :::

### Why This Verse One of Isaiah's greatest invitations ### Chapter Insight This chapter reveals God's sovereignty through Cyrus and His plan for Israel. The key verse declares that the Lord alone is God and there is no other. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 46
Isaiah 46:4
Even to your old age I am He
### Why This Verse Promise of lifelong care ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts God with powerless idols. The key verse emphasizes God's ability to carry and sustain His people throughout life. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 47
Isaiah 47:10
Thy wisdom and thy knowledge have perverted thee
### Why This Verse Warning against pride ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces judgment upon Babylon. The key verse reveals the downfall of pride and self-sufficiency. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 48
Isaiah 48:17
I am the LORD thy God who teaches thee to profit
### Why This Verse Divine guidance ### Chapter Insight This chapter rebukes Israel's stubbornness while affirming God's faithfulness. The key verse highlights God's refining work through adversity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 49
Isaiah 49:16
I have graven thee upon the palms of My hands
### Why This Verse Powerful image of God's remembrance ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents the Servant of the Lord as a light to the nations. The key verse expands God's salvation beyond Israel to all peoples. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 50
Isaiah 50:7
I have set my face like a flint
### Why This Verse Messianic determination ### Chapter Insight This chapter emphasizes the Servant's obedience amid suffering. The key verse demonstrates steadfast trust in God despite opposition. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 51
Isaiah 51:11
The redeemed of the LORD shall return
### Why This Verse Restoration promise ### Chapter Insight This chapter calls God's people to remember His faithfulness. The key verse encourages confidence in God's everlasting salvation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 52
Isaiah 52:7
How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet
### Why This Verse Quoted in Romans 10 ### Chapter Insight This chapter announces redemption and introduces the suffering Servant. The key verse proclaims the beauty of those who bring good news. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 53
Isaiah 53:5
He was wounded for our transgressions
### Why This Verse Perhaps the most important messianic prophecy ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the suffering and sacrifice of the Servant. The key verse reveals that the Servant bears the sins of others to bring healing and redemption. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 54
Isaiah 54:17
No weapon formed against thee shall prosper
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted promises in Scripture ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises restoration and covenant blessing. The key verse assures God's enduring love despite past affliction. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 55
Isaiah 55:8
My thoughts are not your thoughts
### Why This Verse Widely quoted statement of God's transcendence ### Chapter Insight This chapter invites all people to receive God's grace freely. The key verse calls the thirsty to come and receive God's provision. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 56
Isaiah 56:7
My house shall be called a house of prayer
### Why This Verse Quoted by Jesus ### Chapter Insight This chapter extends God's welcome to foreigners and outcasts. The key verse reveals God's desire for His house to be a house of prayer for all nations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 57
Isaiah 57:15
I dwell with him that is of a contrite spirit
### Why This Verse God's nearness to the humble ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts the fate of the righteous and the wicked. The key verse promises God's presence with the humble and repentant. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 58
Isaiah 58:6
Is not this the fast that I have chosen?
### Why This Verse Foundational justice passage ### Chapter Insight This chapter defines true fasting and genuine righteousness. The key verse emphasizes practical compassion and justice. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 59
Isaiah 59:1
The LORD's hand is not shortened
### Why This Verse God's ability to save ### Chapter Insight This chapter explains how sin separates people from God. The key verse highlights God's power to save despite human failure. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 60
Isaiah 60:1
Arise, shine; for thy light is come
### Why This Verse One of Isaiah's most famous calls ### Chapter Insight This chapter foretells Zion's future glory. The key verse calls God's people to arise because His light has come. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 61
Isaiah 61:1
The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me
### Why This Verse Read by Jesus in Luke 4 ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents the mission of the Anointed One. The key verse proclaims good news, healing, liberty, and restoration. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 62
Isaiah 62:1
For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace
### Why This Verse Commitment to restoration ### Chapter Insight This chapter promises Jerusalem's future vindication. The key verse emphasizes God's commitment to His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 63
Isaiah 63:9
In all their affliction He was afflicted
### Why This Verse Divine compassion ### Chapter Insight This chapter reflects on God's past mercies and coming judgment. The key verse celebrates God's role as Redeemer. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 64
Isaiah 64:8
We are the clay, and Thou our potter
### Why This Verse Classic dependence imagery ### Chapter Insight This chapter is a prayer for God's intervention and mercy. The key verse acknowledges God's authority as Creator and Father. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 65
Isaiah 65:17
Behold, I create new heavens and a new earth
### Why This Verse Quoted in Revelation ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts judgment with future blessing. The key verse introduces the promise of a new heavens and a new earth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 66
Isaiah 66:13
As one whom his mother comforteth
### Why This Verse Tender image of God's comfort ### Chapter Insight This chapter concludes Isaiah with themes of worship, judgment, and restoration. The key verse emphasizes humility and reverence before God. :::
